blockedRole.reason: No existing true workspace-admin fixture. The admin-labelled authenticated session has workspace-owner memberships and a separately confirmed instance-admin grant.

databaseSafety: Live 62870 excluded from integration/reset/seed/fixtures. Ordinary SIT auth/session and own active-workspace preference operations only; no business-record create/edit/delete commands issued by this browser audit.
method: One authenticated route load per theme, then same-page resize across three widths; agent shell/sidebar and skeleton readiness awaited. Dynamic detail IDs resolve from existing persisted links or read-only list APIs. Read-only business-data audit; the lead selected its existing lead workspace through the normal UI. Authenticated role/active-workspace assertions run before each role batch. The instance-admin/owner crawl is supplementary, never workspace-admin evidence.
limits: Recorded cases include missing fixtures with no navigation; resolved-route variants record explicit readiness, denial, auth, fixture or timeout statuses, not passes. Six original customer catalogue states are corrected from settled_content to loading_observed_unverified after visual review found plain Loading text. All66 customer cases have a separate corrected follow-up in l01-sit-scope.json; quiet timeout rechecks are also separate. No existing workspace-admin fixture (#914), so requested matrix is incomplete even when the crawl finishes. Redirects show the final path and do not prove the original screen rendered. Missing persisted detail rows, provider journeys and any errors remain verification limits. Only reviewed surviving representative screenshots are linked. Route loading/basic Tab sampling does not establish feature behavior, every keyboard interaction, pixel parity or whole-clause acceptance. Chromium viewport resizing does not establish physical touch-device coverage. No cookies, credentials, signed URLs, raw logs or traces included.
